'''August 2000 Augusta tournament (20 August)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Book Exchange, Augusta, GA on 20 August 2000. [[Paul Myers]] won it. It is known from Paul Myers's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1154">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-22-augusta-ga-8-20-00-longest-tr-everd1154/ augusta-ga-8-20-00-longest-tr-ever], DeckTech (Paul "lbmyers1" Myers, 22 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-22-augusta-ga-8-20-00-longest-tr-everd1154/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Book Exchange, Augusta, GA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Myers]]
